1.text: Pawulo wagizwe intumwa ya Kristo Yesu, ku bw'itegeko ry'Imana Umukiza wacu na Kristo Yesu ari we byiringiro byacu,

2.text: ndakwandikiye Timoteyo, umwana wanjye nyakuri nibyariye mu byo kwizera. Ubuntu n'imbabazi n'amahoro bibe kuri wowe, biva ku Mana Data wa twese no kuri Kristo Yesu Umwami wacu.

3.text: Ugume muri Efeso nk'uko nakwinginze ubwo najyaga i Makedoniya, kugira ngo wihanangirize bamwe kutigisha ukundi,

4.text: cyangwa kwita ku migani y'ibinyoma cyangwa amasekuruza atagira iherezo, bidafasha umurimo w'Imana wo kwizera ahubwo bizana impaka.

5.text: Ibyo mbibategekeye kugira ngo bagire urukundo ruva mu mutima uboneye kandi uticira urubanza, bagire no kwizera kutaryarya.

6.text: Ibyo bamwe babiteshutsemo biyobagiriza mu biganiro by'amanjwe,

7.text: bashaka kuba abigisha b'amategeko, nyamara batazi ibyo bavuga ibyo ari byo cyangwa ibyo bahamya babishegera.

8.text: Icyakora tuzi ko amategeko ari meza koko iyo umuntu ayagenjeje uko bikwiriye amategeko,

9.text: kandi tuzi ko amategeko atashyiriweho umukiranutsi, keretse abagome n'ibigande, n'abatubaha Imana n'abanyabyaha, n'abatari abera n'abatita ku by'Imana, n'abakubita ba se na ba nyina, n'abicanyi

10.text: n'abasambanyi n'abagabo bendana, n'abanyaga abantu bakabagura, n'ababeshyi n'abarahira ibinyoma, n'ibindi byose bidahura n'inyigisho nzima,

11.text: zihuje n'ubutumwa bwiza bw'ubwiza bw'Imana ihimbazwa, ubwo nahawe.

12.text: Ndashimira Kristo Yesu Umwami wacu wambashishije, yuko yatekereje ko ndi uwo kwizerwa, akangabira umurimo we

13.text: nubwo nabanje kuba umutukanyi n'urenganya n'umunyarugomo. Ariko narababariwe kuko nabikoze mu bujiji ntarizera;

14.text: kandi ubuntu bw'Umwami wacu bwarushijeho kunsagirizwa, bufatanije no kwizera n'urukundo rubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu.

15.text: Iri jambo ni iryo kwizerwa rikwiriye kwemerwa rwose, yuko Kristo Yesu yazanywe mu isi no gukiza abanyabyaha, muri bo ni jye w'imbere.

16.text: Ariko icyatumye mbabarirwa ni ukugira ngo Yesu Kristo yerekanire muri jye uw'imbere kwihangana kwe kose, ngo mbe icyitegererezo cy'abazamwizera bagahabwa ubugingo buhoraho.

17.text: Umwami nyir'ibihe byose udapf, kandi utaboneka, ari we Mana imwe yonyine, ihimbazwe kandi icyubahiro kibe icyayo iteka ryose, Amen.

18.text: Mwana wanjye Timoteyo, ndakwihanangiriza nkurikije ubuhanuzi bwa kera bwahanuye ibyawe, kugira ngo buduheshe kurwana intambara nziza,

19.text: ukomeje kwizera kandi ufite umutima uticira urubanza. Uwo mutima bamwe barawuretse bahinduka nk'inkuge imenetse ku byo kwizera.

20.text: Muri abo ni Humenayo na Alekizanderi, abo nahaye Satani kugira ngo babyigireho kudatuka Imana.
